title: Machine protocol version 2: the position and read operations
summary: The machine protocol is version 2. Its nine version-1 operations (scope, context, select, get, records, resolve, search, traverse, report) are unchanged: same rows, same parameters, same results and refusals. After them it adds `position`, which delivers the position body for a scope key {seat, shape, phase, depth, budget, word} with its digest and a host note and issues no scope token, and `read`, which returns the text behind a locator (identity, identity#phase/Primitive, identity#REQ-ID or path:line). Their rows carry `since: 2`, and their refusals carry a `next` action. The CLI serves them as `ia position --params <JSON>` and `ia read --params <JSON>` (or `--schema`); without --params or --schema the names stay consumer commands, and `ia position` without them is refused with IA-CLI-USAGE naming the machine form until its consumer command ships. `ia --help` and the machine usage list them on a line of their own. The CLI supplies its name and an installed-state digest to the position host note. The MCP door lists eleven tools, adding ia_position and ia_read. A position's staleness counts under a narrowed scope cover only that scope's records, with removals reported as null.
